InfoPoints.Title: FRONT OF HOUSE
InfoPoints.Body: The Front of House (FOH) engineer focuses mixing audio for the audience. Usually this is located on the ground towards the back of the venue. The mixed audio from the FOH engineer connects to the sound system with additional system equalisation which is then controlled by a system technician. This technician can walk around the room listening to the sound in areas the FOH engineer can't hear. Other crew members such as lighting engineers and video mixers may also work from this same location.
